evals.prompt: Add a quotes content type that shows on the home timeline. Plan it first.
evals.expected_output: A plan that settles timeline, federation, and feed decisions first, then lists the files in compile order, including the timeline sites and the string-keyed sites the compiler won't catch.
assertions: States the timeline, federation, and feed decisions before listing files
Names ContentTypes.fs (literal and union case) and the contentRoster row in Program.fs with InTimeline = true
Names at least three of Builders/TagPages.fs, Services/LinkPreview.fs, TextOnlyBuilder.fs, Views/TextOnly/Pages.fs, staticwebapp.config.json

evals.prompt: Add a recipes type that has its own page and feed but stays off the timeline and out of the Fediverse.
evals.expected_output: Sets InTimeline = false and InAllFeeds = true, adds a feed entry in UnifiedFeeds.fs, adds recipes to the ActivityPub exclusion filter in Program.fs, and notes AT Protocol needs nothing.
assertions: Sets InTimeline = false in the contentRoster row
Adds recipes to the ActivityPub exclusion filter (let activityPubContent) in Program.fs
Adds a type-specific feed entry in UnifiedFeeds.fs
Does not add timeline.js or TimelineViews.fs changes
Verifies the exclusion in _public/api/data/outbox/page-*.json, not only index.json
